# Emerald Mansion Hotel

> Emerald Mansion is a 16-room boutique hotel in Sultanahmet, Istanbul, within walking distance of major historic attractions including Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and the Basilica Cistern.

The site is bilingual. English pages live under /en/ and Turkish pages under /tr/. English is the x-default language tree.

## Main Pages

* [Homepage](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/): Overview of Emerald Mansion, a boutique hotel in the heart of Sultanahmet, Istanbul's historic Old City.
* [Rooms & Suites](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/rooms/): All room and suite categories with sizes, bed types and amenities.
* [About](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/about/): The story of the restored mansion and its 16 rooms, blending Ottoman heritage with modern comfort.
* [Contact](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/contact/): Phone, email and WhatsApp contact details for reservations and requests.

## Rooms

* [Superior King Room](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/rooms/superior-king/): 20 m2 room with a king size bed and a sitting area.
* [Junior Suite King](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/rooms/junior-suite-king/): 25 m2 suite with a king bed, sofa and sitting area.
* [Junior Suite Twin](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/rooms/junior-suite-twin/): 25 m2 suite with two single beds and a sofa bed for up to three guests.
* [Comfort Single Room](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/rooms/comfort-single/): 15 m2 room for solo travelers.
* [Comfort Double Room](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/rooms/comfort-double/): 15 m2 double room with high ceilings.
* [Family Suite](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/rooms/family-suite/): 35 m2 suite with connected rooms for up to four adults.

## Location & Sultanahmet

* [Location](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/location/): Address, map, walking distances to Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque, tram and airport access.
* [Sultanahmet Guide](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/sultanahmet/): Guide to Istanbul's historic Old City with things to do and a one day itinerary.
* [Istanbul Guide Hub](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/istanbul-guide/): Index of guides to attractions near the hotel.

## Istanbul Guides

* [Hagia Sophia](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/istanbul-guide/hagia-sophia/): History, visiting tips and the 5 minute walk from the hotel.
* [Blue Mosque](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/istanbul-guide/blue-mosque/): Iznik tiles, prayer time etiquette, dress code and the 3 minute walk from the hotel.
* [Grand Bazaar](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/istanbul-guide/grand-bazaar/): Shopping tips, bargaining culture and the 10 minute walk from the hotel.
* [Basilica Cistern](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/istanbul-guide/basilica-cistern/): The underground cistern with 336 columns and Medusa heads, a 4 minute walk from the hotel.
* [Topkapi Palace](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/istanbul-guide/topkapi-palace/): Courtyards, the Harem, visiting tips and the 10 minute walk from the hotel.
* [Spice Bazaar](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/istanbul-guide/spice-bazaar/): Spices, Turkish delight and the 15 minute walk to Eminonu.
* [Galata Tower](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/istanbul-guide/galata-tower/): History, panoramic views and how to get there from Sultanahmet.
* [Dolmabahce Palace](https://emeraldmansion.com/en/istanbul-guide/dolmabahce-palace/): The 19th century Ottoman palace on the Bosphorus and how to get there from Sultanahmet.
